document: Propulsion motor requirements - derived from repository sources

electrical_contract.evidence: REV_B_ARCHITECTURE.md design basis: '12S LiPo, 50.4 V maximum charged voltage'. The task prompt's 'six-cell' refers to the six independent ESC motor cells, not cell chemistry.
electrical_contract.duty_note: ESC cells are rated 60 A continuous each; burst limited by +/-140 A linear sense range, MOSFET thermal path, and battery C-rate.

aircraft_requirements.note: No explicit airframe mass/thrust requirement exists in the repository. The conservative documented design point below is parameterized; revisit when airframe data lands.

design_point.type: conservative parameterized point (not a validated propeller)
design_point.propeller: UNSPECIFIED - no validated propeller data in repo; motor is designed around shaft torque/RPM, not a specific prop
design_point.derivation: 2.2 kW continuous x 6 motors = 13.2 kW shaft power, consistent with a heavy-lift hexacopter in the class implied by the 6x60 A = 360 A aggregate electrical budget at 12S (~16 kW electrical).

mechanical_envelope.mounting: standard outrunner face mount, pattern to be fixed in interface drawing

safety_constraints.winding_insulation_class: H (180 C), operating limit 170 C with margin
